d:
"Heya! It's been a minute since my last doujin! Years at this point!

I want to pivot into doing more doujins and comics, so this was a way for me to dust of the techniques. While I still a great deal to improve on, it was a good lesson and refresher. It took about 2 weeks to get this done, but next time around I want to do something longer and take my time to craft it properly!

Without further ado, please enjoy!"
